headline: Sensex jumps nearly 900 points as Nifty tops 25,800 driven by strong FII inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian stock markets defied global market weakness driven by robust foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows.
Investors sought shelter in Indian equities, leading to short unwinding in the market.
The Indian Rupee recorded strong gains against the USD, posting its largest single-day gain in a month.
Market sentiment remained resilient despite concerns around crude oil price gains and inflation risks.
whatHappening: BSE Sensex surged by 897 points to close above the 83,900 mark.
NSE Nifty50 climbed back to top the key level of 25,800.
The Rupee climbed past the 93/USD level due to persistent foreign inflow support.
Ramco Systems announced the digitisation of the Canadian Coast Guard's aviation operations.
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp rally today with Sensex surging nearly 900 points to cross 83,900 and Nifty reclaiming 25,800. Strong foreign institutional investor inflows and unwinding of short positions provided significant support while boosting the Rupee above 93/USD. Among individual stocks, Ramco Systems gained traction following an aviation digitisation contract.
